[The preliminary analysis selected coefficient @num:old-coefficient before contaminant control; that finding is now superseded.]{.claim .historical grounds=finding-20260905T002329Z-use-coefficient-eleven-for-northbridge-calibration} [The rejection record attributes the solvent echo normalization route's reproduction of coefficient @num:old-coefficient to contaminant carry-over into the reference channel. It closes that route unless the reference chemistry changes.]{.claim .historical grounds=event-20260905T002329Z-reject-the-solvent-echo-normalization-route}
